subject: design/wake-watch-v3
statement: Wake-watch-v2 is incorporated as a frozen conformance component at Git object `52d724929450e5bd9db20b36d20c4543af129010`. Its in-process context-owned loop, proposal/task await derivation, adapter-advised cadence, instruction-free wake grammar, state-edge coalescing, idle-zero behavior for its original frontier, status/staleness semantics, local rotated JSONL events, reserved push slot, `DINV-1..DINV-9`, risks, and `A-1..A-13` remain binding and executable. A successor manifest maps every carried Serves/DINV/A anchor to the same named check/digest; omission, mutation, or favorable subset fails A-1.
